cta.title: Try Daily Fortune
cta.description: Download the app and get a new message every day.
cta.ariaLabel: Download Daily Fortune (opens in a new tab)

for_whom.label: Who it's for
for_whom.title: A small boost every morning
for_whom.description: Daily Fortune is not a client project: it is our studio's own app, designed and published by us. It is for anyone looking for a little lift in the morning, a phrase to stay on track or a message to share.

what_we_did.label: What we did
what_we_did.title: A mobile app, from idea to publication
what_we_did.description: We did everything ourselves, from the first idea to the release on the app stores.

items.daily_message: A new message every day: a motivational quote, a positive affirmation or a fortune-cookie saying
items.ai_messages: Varied messages created with the help of AI, in tune with everyone's daily life and hopes
items.clean_design: A clean screen that reacts quickly, with smooth animations
items.stores: Published on the App Store and Google Play, for iPhone and Android

result.label: Result
result.title: Our first app, live
result.description: Daily Fortune is available on the App Store and Google Play, and its users get a new message every day. For you, it means we know the whole journey, from the first idea to publication on the stores.

mcomperat.title: mcomper.at
mcomperat.subtitle: Matthieu Compérat's online résumé, and the testing ground for the tools we then use for our clients.

cta.title: Discover mcomper.at
cta.description: Browse Matthieu Compérat's online résumé, in French or English.
cta.ariaLabel: Visit the mcomper.at website (opens in a new tab)

for_whom.label: Who it's for
for_whom.title: An online résumé, and our testing ground
for_whom.description: mcomper.at is the online résumé of Matthieu Compérat, your contact at Cosmic Studio: his background and expertise on a single page. It is also the testing ground for the tools we then use for our clients. What works here makes its way into your project.

what_we_did.label: What we did
what_we_did.title: A clear, fast résumé in two languages
what_we_did.description: We built a site that is easy to read and easy to update, and we use it to try out our working methods before offering them to clients.

items.two_languages: Available in French and English, with texts written for each language
items.found_on_google: Pages prepared to be found on Google
items.fast_on_phone: Pages that load quickly and are easy to read on a phone
items.accessible: A site accessible to everyone, following good practice
items.ai_with_review: AI as an assistant for writing and translating, with every text reviewed by a person

result.label: Result
result.title: Tested here, then used for you
result.description: Matthieu has a clear, bilingual and fast online résumé. For the studio, it is where we refined how we handle several languages, how pages appear on Google and how AI-assisted texts get reviewed, before using it all on our clients' sites. Every change also goes through automatic checks, to catch mistakes.

choeurDesPaysduMontBlanc.title: Chœur des Pays du Mont Blanc
choeurDesPaysduMontBlanc.subtitle: The website of an amateur choir in Haute-Savoie: concerts, repertoire and rehearsals in one place.

cta.title: Discover the choir
cta.description: Upcoming concerts, repertoire, rehearsals: it is all on the choir's website.
cta.ariaLabel: Visit the Chœur des Pays du Mont Blanc website (opens in a new tab)

for_whom.label: Who it's for
for_whom.title: An amateur choir in Haute-Savoie
for_whom.description: The Chœur des Pays du Mont Blanc is an association of amateur singers in Haute-Savoie. It needed one place to keep its members informed, make its concerts known and welcome new voices.

what_we_did.label: What we did
what_we_did.title: A website for singers and the public
what_we_did.description: We brought together everything singers, music lovers and the general public look for on a single site, easy to read on a computer or a phone.

items.concerts: A concert calendar with dates, venues and programmes
items.repertoire: A look at the repertoire, from baroque to contemporary classical music
items.join: Rehearsal times and how to join the choir
items.news: News and events from the life of the choir

result.label: Result
result.title: One place to follow the choir
result.description: The site has become the choir's main meeting point: members find rehearsal times and news, the public discovers upcoming concerts, and anyone who wants to sing knows how to join.
